product_one_liner.value: Axure RP is an all-in-one, no-code UX design tool for UX professionals, business analysts, product managers and teams to create realistic functional prototypes, diagrams and specifications and share them for feedback and development handoff.

pricing_page.notes: The page lists Pro, Team and Enterprise plans and prices for Pro and Team.

named_customers.notes: These names appear on Axure's customer page in customer/service-user examples.

employee_band.notes: The available company profiles report 11-50 or 17 employees; 17 maps to the requested 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: Axure's company profile identifies San Diego, California; its pricing page gives the San Diego mailing address.

eng_blog.notes: The readable index is an updates, product-feature and UX-tips blog; it does not show at least two engineer-authored posts about product architecture, infrastructure, ML, data, incidents or open source.

public_docs.notes: Axure publishes extensive RP and Axure Cloud documentation and a docs site.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The available Axure careers posting is Product Support Specialist, and the current third-party Axure posting is Software Engineer; neither is an AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The public materials describe connections to third-party AI tools and list infrastructure/subprocessors, but do not say which model provider Axure's product uses.

compliance_certs.notes: Axure explicitly says it is ISO 27001 certified. GDPR is described as a compliance commitment, not as a certification, so it is not included.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn reports Axure as unfunded and says it has raised no funding rounds; Crunchbase identifies it as privately held and shows no funding round.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile says Axure has not raised any funding rounds.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The available Axure role listings show Product Support Specialist and Software Engineer, not SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The blog index is readable; its newest launch-type feature item is Documents and Whiteboards dated February 26, 2025, before the six-month window. The July 2026 item is an end-of-updates notice, not a product launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available company materials identify leadership but do not provide a sufficiently complete, dated team history to verify a C-level or VP join/leave during the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Axure's subprocessors table identifies HubSpot for email marketing and analytics and Mailchimp for email marketing.
